record.field:
Follow these steps to connect Calendly and synchronize meetings with Odoo.

StepTaskInstructionsExpected result
1Create Calendly credentialsCreate an OAuth application with redirect URL https://your-odoo-host/calendly/oauth/callback, or generate a Personal Access Token.OAuth client credentials or a PAT is ready to enter in Odoo.
2Save credentials in OdooOAuth: enter Client ID, Client Secret, and Webhook Signing Key.
PAT: enter Personal Access Token and Webhook Signing Key.		All required credential fields are saved for the selected company.
3Verify connectionFor OAuth, click Connect Calendly and approve access. For PAT, click Test Connection.Connection Status changes to Connected.
4Activate webhookClick Register Webhook after connecting. Do not change the Webhook Signing Key while it is active.Calendly booking notifications are accepted and verified by Odoo.
5Link an Event TypeClick Calendly Event Type Sync. Open Calendar → Meeting → Calendly Details, select an Event Type, and save.The Odoo meeting has a Calendly Event Type selected for booking.
6Enable inbound synchronizationEnable Automatic Calendly → Odoo Sync, or click Calendly to Odoo Sync for a manual recovery.New Calendly bookings create or update Odoo Calendar meetings.
7Enable outbound synchronizationEnable Automatic Odoo → Calendly Sync. Ensure the meeting has a start time and an attendee email.Eligible Odoo meetings are created as Calendly bookings.
8Check synchronization logsOpen Calendly → Sync Logs. Review status, direction, Event Type, Calendar Event, errors, and responses. Retry failed logs as an administrator.Each synchronization result is traceable, and failed records can be retried.
9Cancel a bookingArchive or delete a linked Odoo meeting while outbound synchronization is enabled. Removing only the Event Type does not cancel a booking.The linked Calendly booking is canceled only when the Odoo meeting is archived or deleted.
10Understand log stagesPending: synchronization started and is waiting for completion.
Success: synchronization completed successfully.
Failed: validation, credentials, API, or processing error occurred.
Skipped: no synchronization was required or the event type was unsupported.		The status shows the current result of each synchronization attempt.
